name: musicroom
description: Listen to music in sync with friends

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('node', ['server/index.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
